records.source_statement: Late section asks whether marriage shall be perfected, assigning first lord/Moon to asker and seventh lord to sought party.
First lord or Moon joined to seventh lord in the latter's dignity and certain houses is called a strong sign of completion.
limitations: House, lord and dignity requirements together.

records.source_statement: Sextile/trine between rulers from listed houses is favourable only without prohibition, frustration, abscission or retrogradation.
Square or opposition without reception is called failure; source contrasts hard aspect with reception.
limitations: Reception changes result, not generic hard aspect.
